user.title: Atodosol Instalaciones Fotovoltaicas
user.description: Choose how to connect your inverter.

automatic.title: Find your inverter
automatic.description: Detected networks: {networks}. Confirm or edit the private IPv4 range. Large networks use a suggested /24 range; you can scan another range up to /22. The search runs from Home Assistant, reads identification only and takes up to 45 seconds.

choose.title: Inverters found
choose.description: Select your inverter by serial number and IP address. Identification confirms a Deye-compatible inverter, not a particular dongle model.

not_found.title: No compatible inverter found
not_found.description: Check that the dongle and Home Assistant share a reachable LAN, Modbus TCP is enabled on port 502, and Slave ID is 1. Networks behind a router or Docker may require another range or a manual IP.

scan_failed.title: Search could not complete
scan_failed.description: Check the network connection or enter the IP manually.
